extraction.title: Google banks on AI edge to catch up to cloud rivals Amazon and Microsoft
extraction.summary: Google Cloud is leveraging its proprietary AI chips and models to enhance its competitiveness against Amazon and Microsoft in the cloud computing market. CEO Thomas Kurian highlights a significant revenue increase and strategic investments in AI technology, positioning Google as a strong contender despite its current third-place status.
